title: The Dog Night, 2005
logline: Six years. The dog is slower on the gravel behind the Lanes. The strip notices in the spacing of the panels.

panels.composition: The dumpster. The bulb. WOOD standing. BARNABY arriving a beat behind him, drawn in the panel's near corner, still coming.

image.prompt: a young man standing behind a bowling alley at night before a rusted dumpster under a yellow bulb, a small dog still arriving at the edge of the panel a step behind, muddy watercolor, no words

panels.composition: The dog, arrived. Sitting. Gray muzzle. Breath visible.

image.prompt: close-up of a gray-muzzled dog sitting under a bulb at night with its breath visible, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting down on the gravel beside him. Eye level. The first Dog Night where Wood sits.

image.prompt: a young man sitting down on wet gravel beside a small dog at night under a bulb so their heads are level, no words

panels.composition: Walking away, slowly, the two of them the same speed now. The neon, all lit, pink and blue.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog walking away at the same slow pace under a bowling alley's pink and blue neon, watercolor, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Wood sits. The dog is six. The strip matches his pace.
